facts.fact: StackAdapt's footfall attribution data collection only occurs after notice has been given, consent has been obtained, and location sharing is enabled.
facts.quote: This data is obtained only after notice has been given, consent has been obtained, and location sharing is enabled.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states its verified third-party location partners report on the actual devices that may have visited a location after seeing an ad, as well as projected future visits, with near-real-time reporting.
facts.quote: StackAdapt uses verified 3rd-party location partners that report on the actual devices that may have visited a location as a result of seeing an ad

facts.fact: Footfall attribution measures uplift in visits by comparing customers exposed to a campaign against a control group that did not see the ads.
facts.quote: This is done by comparing the results of customers who were exposed to a campaign to a control group that didn’t see the ads.

facts.fact: Footfall is measured by pseudonymously tracking signals from mobile devices and matching these signals to ads the customers saw.
facts.quote: Footfall is measured by pseudonymously tracking signals from mobile devices and matching these signals to ads the customers saw.

facts.fact: Visit rate identifies the average daily visits by specific customer segments in footfall attribution.
facts.quote: Visit rate identifies the average daily visits by specific customer segments.

facts.fact: Footfall attribution is also known as foot traffic attribution and is a measurement method connecting in-store traffic to digital marketing campaigns.
facts.quote: Footfall attribution (also known as foot traffic attribution) is a measurement method used to connect in-store traffic to digital marketing campaigns.

facts.fact: The page states that high footfall indicates strong customer interest in the products and services sold in a business's brick and mortar locations.
facts.quote: High footfall is good because it indicates strong customer interest in the products and services sold in your brick and mortar locations.

facts.fact: The page states that higher footfall generally leads to increased sales because more potential customers visiting a business can lead to more purchases.
facts.quote: Higher footfall generally leads to increased sales because having more potential customers visit your business can lead to more purchases.
